detailed_descriptions.en: From the creators of Scribblenauts comes a new 2–6 player competitive sandbox party game where wizard roommates vie to make rent! Slay monsters, play prop hunt, race hoverboards, and take on crazy jobs to pay your giant Imp Landlord first! GIG WORK FOR WIZARDS From saving towns to exploring the backrooms to racing magical ravens to playing every wizard's favorite snake clone on your phone: Slitherin'! The world is full of unique jobs to take on. Some pay well. Others are quick and easy. VIBE OUT Chill with friends in Freeplay Mode, kick back together and watch videos, jam on instruments, play tag, PvP in the player arena, set off some fireworks. Sometimes slacking off is the point. CUSTOMIZE YOUR WIZARDS Earn tickets to try on new hoodies, unlock new magic boards, craft some hats or wings to equip. Or find and hatch some Pocketdragon eggs to add a buddy. EARN MAGIC KEYS Take a break from competition and explore the neighborhood in search of Magic Keys! Collect them all to open the treasure chest holding your deed and be rid of your Imp Landlord for good! FEATURES * Compete with up to 6 players * Tons of Mini-Games to play * Focus on progress or just slack off! * In-Game Voice Chat * Secrets to unlock and Mysteries to solve! * Character Customization * Lobbies for Public and Private Games

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
From the creators of Scribblenauts comes a new 2–6 player competitive sandbox party game where wizard roommates vie to make rent! Slay monsters, play prop hunt, race hoverboards, and take on crazy jobs to pay your giant Imp Landlord first!

GIG WORK FOR WIZARDS

From saving towns to exploring the backrooms to racing magical ravens to playing every wizard's favorite snake clone on your phone: Slitherin'! The world is full of unique jobs to take on. Some pay well. Others are quick and easy.

VIBE OUT

Chill with friends in Freeplay Mode, kick back together and watch videos, jam on instruments, play tag, PvP in the player arena, set off some fireworks. Sometimes slacking off is the point.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR WIZARDS

Earn tickets to try on new hoodies, unlock new magic boards, craft some hats or wings to equip. Or find and hatch some Pocketdragon eggs to add a buddy.

EARN MAGIC KEYS

Take a break from competition and explore the neighborhood in search of Magic Keys! Collect them all to open the treasure chest holding your deed and be rid of your Imp Landlord for good!

     

FEATURES

* Compete with up to 6 players

* Tons of Mini-Games to play

* Focus on progress or just slack off!

* In-Game Voice Chat

* Secrets to unlock and Mysteries to solve!

* Character Customization

* Lobbies for Public and Private Games
